name: Vlad Dracula X
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (20 July 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/critique-please-vlad-dracula-x-first-roleplay-1999-07-20.html: 'Vlad Dracula the tenth', from England, speaks from the darkness of a Seattle goth club about his match with Uchrin.
caption: A vampire-voiced Englishman who warned a camera man in a Seattle goth club before Hammerlock's first card, July 1999.
